features.evidence: 2026-08-06 read-only audit: Security Advisor reports two warnings only. donelvit.set_updated_at has no fixed search_path; its current body only assigns new.updated_at = now() and returns new. Proposed SQL is CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION donelvit.set_updated_at() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = donelvit, pg_temp AS $$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $$;. The second warning is Auth leaked-password protection disabled; Supabase documentation says it is enabled in Auth settings and available on Pro plan or above. No setting or database change was applied during the audit.

features.name: AI analysis of uploaded project documentation
features.description: Allow an authenticated employee to submit a local PDF or DOCX for transient analysis against the selected Moldova verification profile and receive recommendations for identified discrepancies.
acceptance_criteria: An authenticated employee can select a PDF or DOCX on their computer and choose an object profile.
The server sends the file to OpenAI without persisting the source document and returns a structured internal-verification report.
The report contains findings, severity, normative reference, evidence and recommendations, with an explicit non-official disclaimer.
The API key is server-only and no unapproved Supabase schema, storage policy or RLS change is made.
features.evidence: 2026-08-06: User explicitly approved transient processing of project documentation through the OpenAI API and no permanent storage of the source file. Initial implementation used a 4 MB request limit and server-side base64. It has now been replaced by a private Vercel Blob store (`donelvit-verification`, Frankfurt) connected to Production and Preview with server-only BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN. The authenticated browser uploads PDF/DOCX directly to a private, user-scoped Blob path; the API issues a ten-minute presigned GET URL only to OpenAI and deletes the Blob in finally after every analysis attempt. Upload size is now 50 MB, matching OpenAI's current per-file and combined Responses file-input limit. The key remains server-only; neither source nor result is persisted in Supabase. User acceptance exposed an OpenAI 400 caused by sending mutually exclusive `filename` and `file_url` fields. The API route now sends only `file_url`, in accordance with official Responses file-URL examples. The user also made NCM G.02.01:2017, NCM C.01.08:2025 and NCM E.03.03-2018 mandatory for project verification: they are shown as official EDNC sources and injected as the priority normative basis in every analysis; C.01.08:2025 is explicitly marked not applicable rather than misapplied outside residential apartment buildings. `npm run typecheck` and `git diff --check` passed; local next build remains blocked before application compilation by Windows sandbox spawn EPERM. Production commit 821aece deployed as dpl_BL1ftd5jyt7BNPYxBh4TGw76d3ZW (READY). Remaining acceptance: run one authenticated PDF/DOCX analysis with the corrected API request and verify automatic Blob deletion.
